page.overview:
What is Adventure Chica the Chicken?

is one of the starter characters in FNaF World, and is one of the selectable protagonists in the troll game FNaF World: Halloween Edition.

Chica is a yellow-colored chicken animatronic with purple eyes, appearing as a smaller version of her counterpart from the core game series. She wears a bib reading "LET'S EAT!!!" and carries a plate with a pink cupcake. She also sports two buck teeth and has three toes instead of two, unlike her counterpart from the first game. Another difference is that there are no white claws on her feet, again unlike the counterpart. She also lacks eyebrows. Like Adventure Toy Chica, her cupcake has blue eyes. Also unlike the her core series counterpart, Chica has a set of eyelashes, much like the rest of Chica's counterparts in FNaF World.

Chica revolves solely around healing and is great for the beginning part of the game. She's an average addition to the party for the first quarter of the game, but can be easily replaced with better counterparts like Adventure Withered Chica. Cupcake and Regen Song are great healing moves for the start of the game but Party Favors is a very lackluster move and deals little damage and little healing, so when starting a new game Adventure Toy Chica would be better, seeing that she can heal, buff up teammates and has Waterhose, which kills all enemies under 30% health. As soon as a new character is unlocked, the player should replace her with them, and try and get a Medpod, so that they do not have to rely on healing as much.
